title: The store listing: screenshots, description, keywords and assets

videos.script:
The store page is the only part of your app most people ever see. {{page}} They read a name, glance at three screenshots, and decide in seconds. Everything else in the app comes after that decision.

Each store gives you a fixed set of boxes. {{boxes}} A name of thirty characters. A short line under it. A description, some keywords, and pictures of exact sizes. Every limit is checked when you upload, not when you write.

So today the listing becomes files. {{files}} One folder per language, a text file per field, and a script that checks every limit before a store does.

And you will watch one limit catch the Portuguese and not the English. {{bytes}} Apple counts keywords in bytes, and an accent costs two.
